ns2:course.label: Field Geology
ns2:course.description: Group field study in a prominent geologic locality; includes in-class meetings, student-led presentation, and field trip; trips run during spring break, winter break, in mid-end May or intercession; dates depend on location. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. Field trip fee required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. Field trip fee required.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Field Trip Fee estimated to be $800 - $2500, depending on the destination and duration of the trip.
